ruleDefinitions.name: Netsh Allow Group Policy on Microsoft Defender Firewall
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may modify system firewalls in order to bypass controls limiting network usage

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*advfirewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*firewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*set.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*rule.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*group\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*new.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*enable\\=Yes.*")))
